description: Cosmopolitan capital where royal palaces, world-class museums, and centuries of history meet a buzzing modern city.
Scotland's medieval capital, crowned by a hilltop castle and wrapped in cobbled closes and dramatic crags.
A romance of Baroque palaces and gondola-dotted canals, where every corner opens onto water and history.
The Eternal City, where ancient ruins, Renaissance art, and vibrant piazzas mingle with today's Italian life.
Gateway to the pyramids, where historic mosques and bustling bazaars sit beside the timeless Nile.
Ecuador's high-altitude capital, rich in Spanish colonial history and framed by dramatic Andean peaks.
